plot.caption: paced most like their own race

method: Each start-screened edition with at least 500 finishes, in races with three or more such editions (193 editions, 23 races, 3,813,745 finishes): the median of each 5K section's pace relative to the finish's own 5–20K pace, 5–10K to 35–40K; the nearest other edition by Euclidean distance over those seven values, against the share a random other edition would give. "The race" covers its course, field and weather together, and is grouped by race name. In 9 of the 23 races, half or more of the editions are nearest to the same race.
